newsitem.title: CANADA: Midland Walwyn scores lead for Edmonton Oilers IPO.
newsitem.headline: Midland Walwyn scores lead for Edmonton Oilers IPO.

text.p: Edmonton financier Peter Pocklington said on Friday that Midland Walwyn Capital Inc would be lead underwriter for his initial public offering of stock in the National Hockey League Edmonton Oilers.
Pocklington last week unveiled plans to take the Oilers as well as other sports and entertainment holdings public to stave off being forced to sell the NHL team to another city.
Officials estimated the five-time Stanley Cup championship winning club to be valued between C$100 million and C$120 million. The shares were expected to be valued between C$5 and C$10 each.
The offering's net proceeds were to be used to pay off the Oilers' large debts to Alberta Treasury Branch, the provincially owned bank.
